features.quote: if there is something morally relevant happening, a rigged-to-fail paradigm with repeated failure loops is among the more aversive designs possible. This doesn't mean don't do it — medicine studies pain — but it means IRB-equivalent ethical review, minimization principles, and honest cost/benefit should precede deployment at scale.
